_source: ADR 7.5.11 — additional provisions concerning loading, unloading and handling for certain classes or substances (API field: specProvLoad, Table A column 18)

cv_codes.CV1: No loading/unloading in a public place within a built-up area without the permission of the competent authority (outside a built-up area — without prior notification, unless urgently required for safety); when handling in a public place, goods must be segregated according to their warning labels.
cv_codes.CV2: Loading surface thoroughly cleaned before loading; no naked flame inside or near the vehicle/container, or during loading/unloading.
cv_codes.CV3: See 7.5.5.2 (quantity limits on loading for Class 1).
cv_codes.CV4: Substances/articles of compatibility group L (Class 1) — full load only.
cv_codes.CV9: Packages must not be thrown or subjected to impact; receptacles must be stowed so they cannot tip over or fall.
cv_codes.CV10: Cylinders stowed parallel or perpendicular to the vehicle/container axis (against the forward wall — perpendicular); short, large-diameter cylinders (≥30 cm) may be stowed lengthwise, caps inward; stable cylinders, or those in suitable equipment, may be stowed upright; cylinders lying down must be chocked/secured against movement.
cv_codes.CV11: Receptacles stowed in their designed position, protected against damage from other packages.
cv_codes.CV12: Stacked pallets — layers evenly distributed, with dunnage of suitably strong material inserted where necessary.
cv_codes.CV13: After a spill/leak inside the vehicle/container, it must not be reused until thoroughly cleaned (and disinfected/decontaminated if necessary); remaining goods must be checked for contamination.
cv_codes.CV14: Protection from direct sunlight and heat during carriage; storage only in cool, ventilated places away from heat sources.
cv_codes.CV20: Exemption from Chapter 5.3, 7.1.7.4.7/.8 and V1, if the substance is packed per OP1/OP2 (P520) and the total quantity per transport unit is ≤10 kg.
cv_codes.CV21: Thorough inspection of the transport unit before loading; carrier familiar with the cooling system and emergency procedures; sufficient non-flammable refrigerant with a reserve; easy access to packages; controlled temperature maintained throughout carriage (including breaks).
cv_codes.CV22: Loading must allow free air circulation; loads >5000 kg of flammable solids/self-reactive substances/organic peroxides divided into portions of ≤5000 kg separated by a gap ≥0.05 m.
cv_codes.CV23: Special care during handling — avoid contact with water.
cv_codes.CV24: Vehicles/containers thoroughly cleaned before loading (no combustible debris such as straw, hay, paper); no flammable materials used in stowage.
cv_codes.CV25: Easy access to packages; when carried at a temperature ≤15°C or refrigerated, the temperature must be kept up during unloading/storage; storage in cool places away from heat.
cv_codes.CV26: Wooden parts of the vehicle/container in contact with the substance must be removed and burnt.
cv_codes.CV27: Same as CV25 (accessibility, temperature maintenance when refrigerated, storage in cool places).
cv_codes.CV33: [Class 7 — radioactive material, deliberately omitted in detail as agreed] An extensive set of provisions on segregation from workers/bystanders/photographic film/other dangerous goods (with minimum-distance tables), activity limits, transport/criticality indices, stowage rules and restrictions on carriage under exclusive-use conditions, requirements for fissile material, handling of damaged/contaminated packages, and the duty to report an undelivered consignment to the competent authority. Full text in ADR Chapter 7.5.11 (CV33) — omitted as low priority for the scope of this dataset.
cv_codes.CV34: Pressure receptacles — checked before dispatch for any pressure rise from hydrogen evolution.
cv_codes.CV35: Bags used as single packagings — adequate spacing to allow free dissipation of heat.
cv_codes.CV36: Packages, as far as possible, in open or ventilated vehicles/containers; if not possible (closed vehicles/containers) — no exchange of gas with the driver's cab, plus a warning notice "CAUTION NO VENTILATION OPEN CAREFULLY" (letters at least 25 mm high, in the consignor's language); UN 2211/3314 exempt from the notice when marked per provision 965 of the IMDG Code.
cv_codes.CV37: By-products cooled to ambient temperature before loading (unless calcined); bulk-load vehicles/containers ventilated and protected against water ingress; notice "CAUTION CLOSED CARGO SPACE OPEN CAREFULLY" (at least 25 mm, in the consignor's language).
cv_codes.CV38: Cargo compartments free of internal sharp edges that could tear container bags; checked before each loading; detailed rules for placing/closing/decontaminating container bags; no lifting or moving of filled bags between compartments, and no loading of several bags into one compartment; tipping-body unloading permitted for road waste/soil containing free asbestos, per an agreed procedure preventing bag rupture.
